source.text: all primary non-small cell lung cancers otherwise of following types are eligible: squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, large cell carcinoma, bronchioalveolar cell carcinoma, or non-small cell carcinoma not otherwise specified.
Those with prior malignancy in the past 2 years other than non-melanomatous skin cancer or in situ cancer or thyroid cancer.
